title: Premium gekauft nachher 9chf/woche
body: Wird immer noch verfolgt und angewendet. Mega schade, die app ist cool! Aber 36 chf/monat für einen Habit tracker? Nein danke!
author: isa_ger

title: Alles gelöscht
body: Nach jahrelanger Nutzung wurden all meine Daten gelöscht. Keine Reaktion auf meine Anfrage. Ich bin sehr enttäuscht.
author: Selection_1

title: „Habits“ verschwunden!
body: Es scheint ein automatisches Update gegeben zu haben und jetzt sind alle meine gespeicherten Habits weg und keine Wiederherstellung möglich! Echt ärgerlich!
author: wollenwohlkeineschlechtekritik

title: Absturz
body: Stürzt bei jedem Eintrag ab. Frechheit für diesen Preis
author: tammy esser

title: Subscription through the backdoor
body: I’m very disappointed. What a shady developer to not consider old users who had paid for the premium lifetime version and just sneak in a subscription model with an update. Too bad I had not read all the negative reviews beforehand :(
author: wobuxiangxiewodenickname

title: Disappointing
body:
I bought Premium for life a long time ago but that doesn't apply anymore apparently. Still decided to pay for a new yearly subscription, because i really wanted the widget for the iPhone. The widget does not show up. Even after several restarts and logging in and out. Wrote to the support email and insta, no reply even after two weeks. 
I'm really disappointed. I loved the design and simplicity of the app.
author: WildChild616

title: Décevant
body: J’adorais cette application, mais j’ai l’impression qu’ils ont voulu changer de stratégie en faisant des mises à jour. Et je pense que c’est une erreur. Leur message “claim my offer 70%” est permanent à chaque fois que j’ouvre l’appli. C’est envahissant et ça devient juste pas crédible : Le compte à rebours est infini. C’est vraiment dommage, c’était une des meilleures applications que j’utilisais selon moi. J’étais sur le point d’acheter le premium. Heureusement que je ne l’ai pas fait vu toutes les retours de personnes qui ont vu disparaître leur version premium après leurs mises à jours.
author: Helljester

title: To many ads for Premium
body: I opened the App and had it open for only 1 minute and it asked me 1 time if i want premium and 2 times it showed me that Premium is 70% off. And it‘s clear that customers are ripped off so I deleted it immediatly.
author: Misterwasgehtsiedasan13

title: Please stop the PopUp
body: It was surely the best and easiest habit tracker app before the subscription model. It’s also great with it but if you can’t or don’t want to afford the subscription, a “limited time offer” will pop up each and everytime you open the app. And when the “limited time” runs out, it will just renew with even more time. I’m at 60 days now and it won’t shut up about the limited time offer and no way to mute it. I will be switching over to another app.
author: Anni_zi

title: bought premium (for nothing)
body: i loved the app but sadly the new update hides features for early premium clients, so i bought for it but now i have to pay even more. i am so sad because i loved the app but now i can not use it any longer the way i used to (and loved to)
author: lilyyyy7

title: Unsure about app since version 1.41.0
body:
I loved the app and bought the premium package after a few weeks. 

My apps are updated automatically and since version 1.41.0, I can‘t access my premium package (iCloud backup and restore as well as theme are locked). If I restore my previous purchases, it says 'Purchase Restored [...]‘, but I‘m still not able to use all features. 

Hopefully, it is only a bug and will be fixed soon...otherwise a huge no to this app.

(I would usually try to delete and download the app again, but I don‘t want to risk anythinh because of the backup...)

I contacted the support team on January 31, 2021, but have not heard anything!
author: chiara_1421

title: scam
body: same here. had premium and they changed the subscription. i‘m consulting my lawyer now
author: RickyHersh

title: Schade
body: Ich hatte bereits die Premium Version. Die ist aber nach dem UP Date nichts mehr wert. Bin schwer entäuscht und habe das App gelöscht.
author: frafei

title: Very good, but …
body: I really liked the app but they somehow switched to a monthly subscription and now I‘m back to standard even though I bought professional a while back. The developer doesn‘t reply to my emails either. ☹️
author: damdudel

title: Premium gone
body: Paid for the Premium for Life and now they changed to a subscription based premium. Refund everybody or activate premium features again!
author: Sevsko

title: Scam
body: I paid for the premium and now they changed it to a subscription model. Thats a no-go
author: echojunge

title: Premium Update on annual/ monthly bases?!
body:
Simple use, joyful colours and perfect to track one’s habits. I loved the app.  That’s why I bought the premium feature about a year ago. It was 5 chf and it said it was a one time payment option. I even suggested the app to family and friends. 
But someone made an update and now you have to make a monthly or annual payment to get the premium features. Also it is ridiculous to pay for the night/ black option? 
I even tried to contact them but no one replied yet. 
What is going on? Anyone else with the same experience/ problem?
author: AncientmA

title: Entfernen von Premium Features
body: Ich habe Premium bereits gekauft. Seit dem update wurde es zu einem Abo Modell und die bisherigen gekauften Funktionen wurden deaktiviert.

title: Paid for premium - cannot use it anymore
body:
I paid for premium « for life » weeks ago and now it changed to a subscription since the last update. Restoring purchase doesn’t change anything.

When you actually pay « premium for life » it should stay that way for the people who did.
author: eazypizy

title: OneTime purchase to subscription
body:
I bought the premium version to be able to backup my data to iCloud and have the dark theme. With the new version I’m back on the free version and get asked on every startup to buy a yearly subscription (hello youtube)... 
so yeah, sadly seems like we have another app that transitions to subscription model and in the process either forgot about the people that supported and bought it or is trying to pressure some more money out them..
author: Nemoc12

title: Why do we need to pay anually now?
body: I had a premium subscription und loved it! and now you've changed the subscription plan?!?! I do not think that that is very nice!
author: wahdunwmfsjmc

title: Update and now much Premium!
body: I was loving using the app but who decided to make an update and to turn for example the dark mode into a premium feature? Is that a joke? Sorry, but now without me.
author: PatrickHummel

title: Scheint bis jetzt ganz cool
body:
Die App wirkt cool und ich fange mal an. Dass man für 5 Franken auf Premium upgraden kann, ohne monatliche Gebühren zahlen zu müssen, find ich cool, aber ich sehe nicht, wie ich den Hintergrund dunkel machen kann. Kann mir da wer aushelfen?

Verbesserungsvorschlag: macht es so, dass man eine Kalender Übersicht hat und dass man spezifisch angeben kann, an welchen Tagen der Woche man etwas gemacht haben möchte :)
author: Ermurais

title: Health connection
body:
-would be great if the app had a health connection for example to count steps automatically, sleep, trainings and so on ...

-For some habits it would be great if I could select „twice a week“

except of that, I am a very happy premium user, nice interface, nice design (I am a Graphic Designer) keep up the good work!

body:
Does what it promises in a very simple, modern and practical way. Absolutely love it. And guess what? It‘s FREE!

There is one feature I‘d like to suggest having on the app though:
• On which day or days it should remind you. E.g. remind me at the end of the month, remind me every Friday etc.

You guys smashed it! 🤙
